'''''BattleSun Odyssey''''' was an episodic work that was being released in [[41 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
''BattleSun Odyssey'' was briefly mentioned in the sixth chapter of [[Legacy of the Force: Invincible|''Invincible'']], a novel written by [[Troy Denning]] in [[2008]].
